source_scope.stored_unit: directed source-target pair aggregated over the full window
source_scope.included: successful top-level transactions with a non-null recipient
not_stored: event logs and decoded protocol actions

representation_conclusion: Direction and weights are retained in hand-crafted and GNN node features; Node2Vec uses undirected tx-count-weighted walks; GNN message passing is undirected and unweighted. Time and interaction type are not modelled.

sensitivity_decision.decision: not added to the frozen dissertation experiment matrix
sensitivity_decision.reason: A valid directed and weighted GNN comparison is not a one-parameter ablation: it requires direction-aware relation channels or architecture changes, a common weighting design for GraphSAGE and GCN, and multiseed retraining under the M05 standard. Missing temporal and interaction-type data cannot be recovered by model reruns.

materiality: Representation loss is not assumed harmless. Near-zero seed-level in/out degree correlation and concentrated transaction weights show nonredundant direction and weight information, so claims are restricted accordingly.
permitted_claims: Performance of static models on the sampled 90-day top-level transaction graph.
Comparison of an undirected tx-count-weighted Node2Vec representation.
Comparison of unweighted undirected GNN propagation with directed and weighted node features.
prohibited_claims: Complete representation of DeFi or Ethereum interactions.
Direction-aware or amount-aware GNN message passing.
Temporal prediction, temporal stability or causal ordering.
Evidence that omitted direction, weight, time or edge types are unimportant.
